items.metric: LIVE GMV (week Sep 14 to 20, third week of decline, largest fall in the set)
items.effect: At 103 streams that is 5.28 per stream against 18.06 before, so the loss is yield and not stream volume.
items.action: Re-brief the creators holding the top streams and hold stream count near 100 until GMV per stream recovers.

items.metric: Collab invites sent (third week of decline, upstream of sampling)
items.effect: Invites halved while 9,585 DMs went out, and the daily rows show 0 invites on Sep 18 and Sep 19, so inbound demand starves the sample stage two weeks out.
items.action: Restart invites this week toward the prior week's 12,221 using the existing outreach lists before changing message content.

items.metric: Sample requests (third week of decline, feeds late September and October content)
items.effect: Requests fell to 68 while only 16 samples shipped and 12 delivered, so the creator pipeline for October is already smaller than September's.
items.action: Clear the 21 To Review requests today, highest post rate first, and re-screen the 82 expired items.

items.metric: GMV (fourth consecutive decline, with three-week runs in Orders, Units, Affiliate GMV, LIVE GMV, DMs, Collab invites, Sample requests and Samples delivered)
items.effect: The week closed at 602.63 GMV per day against 1,030.93, which is a level shift rather than a partial week effect.
items.action: Track the Sep 21 to 27 week against the 602.63 daily run and treat sample approvals and shipping as the only levers that reach October GMV.

items.metric: GMV Max Back to School campaign ROAS against its 5.4 target
items.effect: The campaign spent 289.66 for 83.97 of revenue, a 205.69 loss before commission and COGS, on 3 orders at 96.55 each.
items.action: Pause or reallocate the 289.66 of weekly spend into Screen Door at 2.000, the only campaign clear of breakeven and nearest its target.

items.metric: Sample pipeline rejection rate (171 of 300 week requests, snapshot moved from the 09-22 read of 58.7%)
items.effect: More than half of inbound sample demand is discarded while 82 requests sit expired and 21 await review, so content supply into November stays capped.
items.action: Screen on post rate and GPM before rejecting and work the expired backlog for creators who still post.
